prompt: I ___ (cook) dinner when the phone rang.
explanation: La acción larga que otra interrumpe va en past continuous; la corta (rang), en past simple.

prompt: While we ___ (drive) home, it started to snow.
explanation: while introduce la acción de fondo, siempre en past continuous.

prompt: She ___ (not / sleep) when I called her last night.
___ (you / work) at eight yesterday evening?
explanation: Was / Were pasa delante del sujeto: el auxiliar did no aparece.

prompt: This time yesterday they ___ (fly) to Lisbon.
We ___ (not / listen) while the teacher was explaining the exercise.
The dog was barking and the neighbours ___ (shout) at that moment.
He was reading in the garden all afternoon.
solution: He was not reading in the garden all afternoon.
explanation: El not va detrás de was / were: was not reading, sin auxiliar did.

prompt: They were arguing about money again.
solution: Were they arguing about money again?
explanation: Were delante del sujeto: Were they arguing?, no Did they were arguing?

prompt: At ten o'clock last night I was still working on the report.
explanation: La acción estaba en curso en un momento concreto del pasado: past continuous.

prompt: While she was cooking, her husband was setting the table.
explanation: Dos acciones largas en paralelo con while: las dos en past continuous.

prompt: At that moment, the wind was blowing and leaves were flying across the road.
explanation: At that moment sitúa dos acciones en curso que describen el fondo de la escena.
